schemaProducts.name: Personalized Full Color 3ply Premium Beverage Napkins
schemaProducts.description:
• Elevate special occasions like anniversaries, weddings, birthdays, graduations, and family reunions with our personalized napkins.
  • Hotels, restaurants, and catering services can discreetly promote their brand with full-color napkins.
  • Transform these napkins into party souvenirs as an advertising tool by adding your brand logos, graphics, and catchy slogans.
  • Crafted from durable 3-ply paper, these napkins offer strength and softness, readily absorbing spills and stains.
  • Create a welcoming atmosphere for your guests by adorning the dining table with our premium full-color beverage napkins.
Country of Origin

Imported

Material

Paper

Size

4.75 Inch x 4.75 Inch

Printing Area

4.25 Inch x 4.25 Inch

Imprint Method

Digitally Printed with 4-Color Process. White and Metallic Imprint Colors are not available for this product.

Napkin Color

Napkin Color is White for all orders. The color(s) you select will apply within the Print Area on the Front Side only. Other sides of Napkins remain White as the original unimprinted product color.

Artwork Position

Your design will be attempted to align approximately center and in the middle of the printable area.

Note

Due to the nature of product material, there might be some very fine lines running through certain types of designs. Colors might vary slightly within a run and is not considered a defect.
